vw_sif_scheme_latest.definition:
SELECT s.scheme_code,
    s.temp_sif_code,
    s.scheme_name,
    a.amc_name,
    s.category,
    s.category_sub,
    s.scheme_plan,
    s.scheme_option,
    s.is_active,
    n.nav_date,
    n.nav,
    q.aaum_quarter,
    q.quarter_end AS aaum_quarter_end,
    q.aaum_cr,
    q.aaum_lakhs
   FROM sif_schemes s
     JOIN sif_amcs a ON a.amc_id = s.amc_id
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT sif_nav_history.nav_date,
            sif_nav_history.nav
           FROM sif_nav_history
          WHERE sif_nav_history.scheme_code = s.scheme_code
          ORDER BY sif_nav_history.nav_date DESC
         LIMIT 1) n ON true
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT sif_aaum_history.aaum_quarter,
            sif_aaum_history.quarter_end,
            sif_aaum_history.aaum_cr,
            sif_aaum_history.aaum_lakhs
           FROM sif_aaum_history
          WHERE sif_aaum_history.scheme_code = s.scheme_code
          ORDER BY sif_aaum_history.quarter_end DESC
         LIMIT 1) q ON true;
